motors.curve_note: XC330 loaded curve points manually approximated from the manufacturer's performance graph, checked 2026-11-21. XL330 uses a provisional linear stall/no-load envelope. 60% is a reference-planning assumption, never a continuous rating.

assumptions: SNU GOM 12-joint contract; geometry/mass/limits may change. A changed topology needs an explicit profile and training adapter review.

This profile explicitly replaces provisional URDF effort=0.15 Nm and velocity=1 rad/s using the 5 V motor envelope. Original position stops remain active. Planning fractions and contacts are provisional, not continuous ratings.
Default collision policy is strict. CAD allowances must be explicit and appear in the report.

kinematics.limits: Discrete full-frame collision inspection; not swept-volume, torque or dynamic balance certification.

limitations: Rigid provisional contacts/inertias, not measured servos or pads.
A failure does not prove RL cannot learn a stabilizing policy.
Short diagnostics do not qualify a whole clip.

reference_screen.torque_allocation: minimum maximum normalized joint torque; all floating-base equations enforced
reference_screen.support_assumption: Optimistic outer projected sole polygon, planned stance only; positive forces, inscribed Coulomb friction pyramid.
limitations: An optimistic necessary-condition screen, not proof of realizable rolling contact or tracking.
Unresolved balance frames are conditional references, not motor-infeasibility evidence.
No continuous-duty, temperature, voltage-drop or measured actuator model.
